name: Moroccan Darija Toxicity Benchmark (OMCD_Typica.ai_Mix)
description: This paper presents a comparative benchmark evaluating the performance of Typica.ai's custom Moroccan Darija toxicity detection model against major LLM-based moderation APIs: OpenAI (omni-moderation-latest), Mistral (mistral-moderation-latest), and Anthropic Claude (claude-3-haiku-20240307). We focus on culturally grounded toxic content, including implicit insults, sarcasm, and culturally specific aggression often overlooked by general-purpose systems. Using a balanced test set derived from the OMCD_Typica.ai_Mix dataset, we report precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy, offering insights into challenges and opportunities for moderation in underrepresented languages. Our results highlight Typica.ai's superior performance, underlining the importance of culturally adapted models for reliable content moderation.
reputation: A niche, language-specific benchmark focused on Moroccan Darija toxicity that fills an important gap for underrepresented languages; adoption is currently limited but valuable for local moderation research.
notes: Culturally grounded and subjective labels can introduce annotation bias; likely class imbalance and small test set sizes; results may not generalize to other dialects or Arabic varieties; potential for annotation disagreement and label noise.
